patch.objective: Installing and pinning dependencies with pip and requirements.txt

sources.note: Read 2026-11-17 through a summarizing fetch. 'Pinning refers to using the == operator to require the package to be a specific version'; hashes can be added to verify downloads, which 'protects against a compromise of PyPI or the HTTPS certificate chain'. That an unpinned requirement installs whatever is newest on the day is implied by the page and stated as the author's.
